description: Get per-insider position aggregates for a ticker: which insiders hold positions in the stock and their aggregate cost and value, derived from Form 4 filings. The figures are not lifetime totals: they cover only the Form 4 history Signal8 holds, which starts at the response's `coverageStart` date (repeated on each row), so every figure is "since coverageStart". Each row carries `costBasisStatus`: `complete` (every share the history knows was bought inside coverage), `partial` (the holding predates coverage, so `weightedAvgCost` averages only in-coverage priced buys and is not the cost of the position), or `unknown` (the first in-coverage event was a sale, or there was no priced buy; `weightedAvgCost` and `costBasisTotal` are null, which means not measured, not zero cost).
name: get_insider_positions_by_ticker
title: Get Insider Positions by Ticker
